info.name: NEXUS BANK — Educational Banking API (simulation)
info.description:
Generated from docs/openapi.generated.json. Educational simulation — not a real bank, no real money moves.

Quick start:
1. Run the API locally (see README) and the seed: `npx prisma db seed`.
2. `POST /auth/login` with `alice@nexusbank.test` / `NexusDemo#2026` (PIN 246810) and copy `data.accessToken` into the `accessToken` collection variable.
3. The refresh token arrives as a SameSite=Strict HttpOnly cookie scoped to /api/v1/auth; this collection captures both header and cookie flows.

All financial mutations require an `Idempotency-Key` header. Destructive admin routes additionally require `X-Admin-Confirmation` (user id, wallet id or transfer id, as documented on the endpoint).

item.name: GET /admin/users/{id} — Get a user with wallet and session counts

request.description: Requires users.manage and X-Admin-Confirmation equal to the target user id. A reason is mandatory and audited.
Requires roles.manage and X-Admin-Confirmation equal to the target user id.

item.name: GET /admin/withdrawals/{id} — Get a withdrawal for review
POST /admin/withdrawals/{id}/approve — Approve a withdrawal and dispatch payout
POST /admin/withdrawals/{id}/reject — Reject a withdrawal and release its hold
POST /admin/withdrawals/{id}/retry-payout — Retry a payout stuck in PROCESSING

request.description: Uses the same provider idempotency key, so a payout cannot be duplicated by retrying.
Requires transfers.reverse, X-Admin-Confirmation equal to the transfer id, and an Idempotency-Key. Posts a compensating journal; the original journal is never mutated.

item.name: GET /admin/ledger/accounts — List ledger accounts with debit/credit totals
POST /admin/ledger/adjustments — Post a manual ledger adjustment

request.description: Requires ledger.adjust, Idempotency-Key and X-Admin-Confirmation equal to the wallet id. Posts a balanced journal against an adjustment system account.

item.name: GET /admin/reconciliation — Read the latest reconciliation snapshot
POST /auth/verify-email — Verify an email address using the one-time token
POST /auth/resend-verification — Resend the verification email (enumeration-safe response)
POST /auth/login — Authenticate with email and password

request.description: Returns tokens immediately, or an MFA challenge when TOTP is enabled. Five failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.

item.name: POST /auth/2fa/verify — Complete an MFA login challenge

request.description: Accepts the HttpOnly refresh cookie or a refreshToken body field. Reuse of an already-rotated token revokes the entire session family and raises a critical security event.

item.name: POST /auth/logout-all — Revoke every session for the current user
POST /auth/reset-password — Reset a password with a one-time token
POST /auth/2fa/disable — Disable TOTP using password and a valid code

request.description: Requires the password. The PIN is HMAC-peppered then Argon2id-hashed.
Returns a provider checkout URL (Stripe test) or a simulated intent. Requires Idempotency-Key. Credits are posted only when a signature-verified webhook settles the deposit.

item.name: POST /deposits/{id}/simulate — Settle or fail a simulated deposit

request.description: Builds a signed simulated-provider event and processes it through the same signature-verification path as a real webhook. Disabled when NODE_ENV=production.

item.name: POST /notifications/read-all — Mark all notifications as read
PATCH /notifications/{id}/read — Mark one notification as read
POST /payment-methods — Create a payout method reference

request.description: Only bank name, last four digits and a generated provider token are stored.

item.name: PATCH /payment-methods/{id}/default — Make a payout method the default
GET /transactions — List all transactions visible to the current user

request.description: Double-entry transfer. Requires a transaction PIN and Idempotency-Key. Source and destination wallets are locked in deterministic order.

item.name: GET /transfers — List transfers involving the current user
DELETE /users/me — Close the current account and revoke all sessions

request.description: Requires zero remaining wallet balance. Audit data is retained.

item.name: GET /users/me/security-events — List recent security events for the current user
GET /wallets — List the current user’s wallets

request.description: Requires an active, verified account. The first wallet is primary.

item.name: GET /wallets/{id} — Get a wallet with its balance projection

request.description: Only possible when the total and held balances are zero.

item.name: GET /wallets/{id}/transactions — List wallet transactions (CSV when format=csv)
GET /wallets/{id}/transactions/export — Export wallet transactions as CSV
POST /webhooks/payments/{provider} — Receive a signed payment provider event

request.description: Authenticity is derived from the raw request body and the provider signature header, never from the source IP. Events are idempotent on (provider, eventId) and amount/currency are validated against the local deposit before settlement.
Places a hold for amount + fee and enters review at or above the configured threshold. Requires a transaction PIN and Idempotency-Key.

item.name: POST /withdrawals/{id}/cancel — Cancel a withdrawal before payout starts

variable.description: User id, wallet id or transfer id, depending on the route
